releaseNotes: Phase handling and classification fallback were widened so competitions with 1st and 2nd phases render more reliably.
changelog: Keeps all detected phases instead of collapsing multi-phase team competitions into the last block.
Accepts generic FPF phase labels such as 1A FASE and 2A FASE GRUPO N.
Shows classification tables even when the selected-club key cannot be inferred perfectly.
Marks the selected row per entry instead of flagging the whole table.
